name: Judah Ike

photo.alt: Portrait of Judah Ike, founder of Cyber_Techx Engineering

tagline: Systems Engineer. Cybersecurity student. Builder of Cyber_Techx.
intro: Cyber_Techx Engineering is led by Judah Ike, known as Cyber: a Systems Engineer and IT professional with hands-on experience in network operations, IT support and cybersecurity.
story: Judah is a curious, driven problem-solver from Anambra State. He has designed secure infrastructure, migrated more than 200 servers to Microsoft Azure and put endpoint protection in place that reduced security incidents by 45%.

He started Cyber_Techx Engineering in 2022 with one goal: help people and businesses adopt technology that is reliable, secure and genuinely useful, and understand what they are buying. Alongside running the company, he is studying for a B.Sc. in Cybersecurity at Miva Open University.
